card.name: Capital C starting a repeated heading word
card.fires_on: The capital letter C (or CH) that begins a new sentence right after a heading or drug name, often repeating it, such as Coadministration, Cimetidine or Closely. It is seen in drug-interaction text.

modes.label: Coadministration after a heading
modes.description: C starts the word Coadministration at the start of an interaction statement.

modes.description: C starts a drug name such as Cimetidine that repeats the heading just before it.

modes.label: CH in capitalized CHRONIC
modes.description: CH begins the all-caps word CHRONIC in a warning heading.
